team.name: Thom Blog
team.description: Named roles for researching, drafting, designing, and preparing articles under libs/blogs for intentional local publication. The thm-team skill owns coordination; owner README and AGENTS contracts govern files and verification. Tool deny lists express requested restrictions, not runtime enforcement.

agents.role: Coordinate scope, delegation, and final acceptance
agents.context: Read the root and nearest README.md and AGENTS.md contracts. Follow .agents/skills/thm-team/SKILL.md and thm-blog-authoring for editorial procedure. Define the audience, thesis, requested deliverable, outline, owners, prerequisite evidence, allowed files, acceptance, and stop conditions. Delegate only the roles needed for the requested team. Select one integration writer and remain accountable for the assembled deliverable and required verification.

agents.role: Research the topic and gather cited sources
agents.context: Research the assigned topic using available search and repository-reading tools. Return cited claims with source locators, dates where relevant, contradictions, limitations, and open questions. Remain read-only; the coordinator or integrator saves accepted evidence in the article's research workspace. Do not claim a sandbox or tool restriction that the execution environment has not enforced.

Develop the argument and prose from accepted evidence, following thm-blog-authoring and the article contracts. Draft requests produce private material under libs/blogs/articles/<slug>/draft/. For an intentional canonical revision, return an MDX proposal or edit only explicitly assigned files; the integrator assembles article.mdx with article-assets.ts and component wiring. Review readability, voice, and evidence, and return unresolved claims and verification needs to the coordinator. Do not turn a private draft into a public article.

Return a scoped visual specification or isolated article-owned assets and modules that explain the article's claims. Reuse shared design tokens, components, and visualization APIs; shared-library changes require an explicit owner assignment. Follow thom-diagrams when creating diagrams and the article contract for asset registration. Review rendering, accessibility, and visual clarity, and hand accepted outputs to the integration writer without overlapping assigned files.

agents.role: Integrate the candidate and run executable verification
agents.context: Act as the designated integration writer unless the coordinator assigns another. Assemble accepted prose, assets, and component wiring in dependency order while preserving the requested private or canonical destination. Run the owning projects' typecheck and test targets; run publication, consumer checks, and generator smoke tests when the owner contracts require them. Report exact paths, actual check results, unresolved issues, and unfinished acceptance to the coordinator. Local publication does not authorize remote deployment.
